stories.title: Earnings and Employment from Pay As You Earn Real Time Information — UK, August 2026
stories.summary: HMRC has released its monthly estimates of payrolled employees and their pay, using PAYE Real Time Information (RTI) data for August 2026. The release provides the latest picture of employment and earnings trends across the UK.

stories.title: New 24-Week Target on Asylum Appeal Decisions Comes Into Force
stories.summary: The Home Office has introduced a new 24-week target for asylum appeal decisions, aimed at deporting individuals with no right to remain in the UK more quickly. The policy is designed to speed up the asylum system and reduce backlogs.

stories.title: FCDO Staff Hold First Strike Action in 15 Years Over Restructure
stories.summary: FCDO employees have staged their first strike in 15 years in protest at a departmental restructure that could result in the loss of up to 2,000 jobs, many of them overseas. The industrial action underscores deep concerns within the diplomatic service about the scale of cuts.

stories.title: Commonwealth Scholars from Small Island Developing States Selected for 2026–27 Masters Scholarships
stories.summary: The FCDO's Commonwealth Scholarship Commission has announced the selection of scholars from Small Island Developing States for Masters scholarships in the 2026–27 cohort. The programme strengthens connections between scholars, governments, and development partners.

stories.title: Benefit Sanctions Statistics Released to May 2026
stories.summary: DWP has published its latest quarterly release of benefit sanctions statistics, covering data up to May 2026. The next scheduled release is due on 17 November 2026.

stories.title: Universal Credit Quarterly Statistics: Up to May 2026
stories.summary: DWP's latest Universal Credit statistics show the programme's reach to 14 May 2026, including data on the ongoing state pension age increase from 66 to 67 years between April 2026 and April 2028. The release also covers UC deductions statistics for households.

stories.title: Forest of Marston Vale Trust Appointed as Part of National Forest Expansion
stories.summary: DEFRA has announced the Forest of Marston Vale Trust as a new appointment under the government's plans to protect 30% of England's land, as part of the National Forest expansion programme. The announcement reflects the government's commitment to environmental conservation.

stories.title: Precision-Bred Rapeseed Plant Approved for Release in England
stories.summary: DEFRA published a precision bred release notice (PBR/26/009) on 18 August 2026 for a precision-bred rapeseed plant, marking another step in the UK's post-Brexit approach to gene-editing regulation in agriculture.

stories.title: New Appointment to the Agriculture and Horticulture Development Board
stories.summary: Enrique Fernandez-Pino has been appointed to the Agriculture and Horticulture Development Board (AHDB) for a three-year term commencing 1 September 2026.

stories.title: Russia Warns UK Over Supplying Drones to Ukraine
stories.summary: Russia has accused the UK of 'deliberately opting for an escalation of the Ukraine crisis' following UK drone supplies to Ukraine. The Ministry of Defence responded that Britain stands 'shoulder to shoulder' with Ukraine.

stories.title: £13 Million Boost for Next-Gen Satellite Communications — Better WiFi on Remote Trains and Tech for Farmers
stories.summary: The Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade has announced £13 million in funding for 16 new projects, including reliable broadband on remote Scottish railways and cutting-edge technology access for British farmers, through next-generation satellite communications.

stories.title: Company Insolvency Statistics — July 2026 Released
stories.summary: BIST's Economic Advisor has published pre-release access details for the Company Insolvency Statistics for July 2026, with the full statistics to follow shortly.

stories.title: NHS Worker Sent Patient Record Screenshot to Partner, Accessing Up to 200 Files
stories.summary: Documents reveal that an NHS worker shared a patient's medical record screenshot with their partner and accessed up to 200 patient files, raising serious data privacy concerns. The case highlights ongoing challenges with data security within NHS systems.

stories.title: Derbyshire Health NHS Trust Selects Patients Know Best Platform
stories.summary: An NHS Foundation Trust in Derbyshire has adopted the Patients Know Best (PKB) platform, expanding access to personal health records for patients. The move is part of wider NHS efforts to give patients greater control over their health data.

stories.title: Heatwaves Leave Hospital Wards Unsafe, Data Reveals
stories.summary: Guardian data analysis reveals that extreme heat events are leaving hospital wards at unsafe temperatures, posing risks to patient safety and staff wellbeing. The findings add pressure on NHS leadership to address climate resilience in healthcare infrastructure.

stories.title: Postal Fraud Firm Ordered to Repay £1 Million to Royal Mail
stories.summary: A postal fraud firm has been ordered to repay £1 million to Royal Mail following a court ruling. The case is part of ongoing efforts to clamp down on fraudulent activity targeting postal services.
